paper.title: Revisiting the link between true-self and morality: Replication and extension Registered Report of Newman, Bloom, and Knobe (2014) Studies 1 and 2

review.reason: Accepted as a reading-only scholarly reconstruction with stated source gaps and no runtime or reanalysis claim.
checks: Shared N=803 cohort, two vignette studies; political orientation is a measured moderator; categorical N=632 and continuous N=803 analyses distinguished.
59 PDF quotations verified at cited physical pages, including Table 9 conservative means, Table 12 boss exception and Table 10/prose F discrepancy. Association and attribution limits retained.
Original QSF randomizers FL_136, FL_130, FL_88, FL_139, FL_132 inspected. Revised public passages remove replay claims without changing findings.
review.reviewScope: Independent public-Program and primary-paper review, with original linked instrument claims checked against archived source files. No raw-data reproduction or protocol-fidelity attestation.
limitations: Web tool could not open external download endpoints in this session; review of archived originals does not certify present remote endpoint availability.
